stem.text: Analysis of the hormone thyroxine gives the results shown.
Heating $0.500\,\text{g}$ of thyroxine with aqueous silver nitrate produces $0.604\,\text{g}$ of silver iodide. All of the iodine in the thyroxine sample is converted to silver iodide.
Complete combustion of $0.500\,\text{g}$ of thyroxine produces $232\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of carbon dioxide and $7.72\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of nitrogen, measured under room conditions.
Which molecular formula of thyroxine agrees with these values?
